item.title: Engineering, Technology, and Sustainability management in the IIoT era: barriers and best practices from evidence
item.content:encoded:
This special issue focuses on challenges and optimal strategies for managing engineering, technology, and sustainability within the Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) landscape. The call invites research examining practical barriers organizations face when implementing IIoT solutions and established best practices supported by empirical evidence that can guide effective adoption and management of these technologies.
